expect.offline: The base and table are left empty in the template (list mode; their cached URLs name base appPSvSKdA6075xJC and table tbl1KgkRF2EEMc2Fq); the overlay fills both Airtable nodes with those ids on both sides. Airtable evaluates the formula, so every lead returned has no icebreaker. Each lead goes through the loop alone: a 5 s Wait (Wait v1.1's default), the Dumpling AI scrape, the OpenAI message (JSON output: icebreaker, email_body, website_summary) and the Airtable update matching on id. The model's text is recorded at run time; Airtable's answer to the update echoes the fields, which no node reads after it.
